mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_logs (feature_name, target_id, user_id, user_ip, status, error_code, execution_time, log_message, created_at) VALUES (#{featureName}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{userIp}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{executionTime}, #{logMessage}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MAX(created_at), '%H:%i') as timeSlot, COUNT(*) as errorCount FROM system_logs WHERE status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) / 600) ORDER BY timeSlot

SELECT feature_name as featureName, AVG(execution_time) as avgTime, COUNT(*) as callCount FROM system_logs WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY feature_name ORDER BY avgTime DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:00') as timeGroup, COUNT(*) as requestCount FROM system_logs WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:00') ORDER BY timeGroup
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(q.reward_points), 0) FROM user_quests uq JOIN quests q ON uq.quest_id = q.quest_id WHERE uq.status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.price * ui.quantity), 0) FROM user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id
SELECT i.name AS itemName, COUNT(ui.item_id) AS salesCount FROM user_items ui JOIN items i ON ui.item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY i.item_id, i.name ORDER BY salesCount DESC LIMIT 5
